A complete quadratic splitting proof gives 1⁶ versus 1²2² Frobenius and rational J[2] orders 16 versus 4. The inversion count proves (q−5)/4 split s-values for every q≡1 mod4. Exact certificate independently counts every p=5 and p=13 parameter using genus-two and elliptic quotient formulas, verifies all 22 quadratic twists, the two mixed t=±2 bins and p=5 exclusion. No extrapolation from finite enumeration is made beyond the symbolic general argument.

value.rationale: Within a canonical and well-studied genus-two isogeny family, the result identifies the smallest eligible prime at which one Weil class has two genuinely different rational Jacobian two-division profiles, not merely two different parameters. It gives all mixed Weil bins and a uniform branch-point splitting explanation for the torsion strata, supplying an exact boundary relevant to refining zeta-function comparisons by 2-torsion.
